name: SpongeBob SquarePants
description: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

videos.overview: SpongeBob meets a land squirrel named Sandy. He is invited to come over to her house, but he finds out that it is full of air. SpongeBob holds out for as long as he can, which isn't a very long time.

videos.title: Jellyfishing

videos.title: Naughty Nautical Neighbors
videos.overview: Squidward is having a peaceful day, until he hears giggling from next door. He gets SpongeBob and Patrick to believe that they hate each other, but now they want to be his best friend.

videos.title: Boating School
videos.overview: SpongeBob is going to take a driving test, a synonym for disaster. This time is a little different, as SpongeBob gets some help from Patrick.

videos.title: Pizza Delivery
videos.overview: A customer calls and asks the Krusty Krab to deliver him some pizza. Mr. Krabs orders SpongeBob and Squidward to deliver it. SpongeBob will stop at nothing to get the pizza to the customer, even if that means getting lost.

videos.title: Home Sweet Pineapple
videos.overview: One night, some nematodes feast on SpongeBob's pineapple house. All that is left is a tiny pebble. Now, SpongeBob must live with his parents! How will he get a new house?

videos.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick find that their television heroes, Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy, are retired old people. SpongeBob and Patrick try to get them back into Superhero business again.

videos.title: Pickles
videos.overview: SpongeBob gives an incomplete Krabby Patty to Bubble Bass for the first time. SpongeBob goes crazy, and forgets how to do everything, including his job.

videos.title: Hall Monitor
videos.overview: SpongeBob is finally given the chance to be a hall monitor at his boating school, but he wastes the school day giving a speech and doesn't get to do anything. That doesn't mean he can't be a Hall Monitor outside of school, right?

videos.title: Jellyfish Jam
videos.overview: A wild jellyfish follows SpongeBob home, so he decides to keep it. The jellyfish loves to party and dance. Unluckily, SpongeBob's house turns into a party overnight with more jellyfish coming by the second.

videos.title: Sandy's Rocket
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally launch Sandy's rocket, and land back in Bikini Bottom. They think they've landed on the moon and that everyone in Bikini Bottom are aliens.

videos.title: Squeaky Boots
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs gives SpongeBob a pair of "special" boots because he bought them for Pearl, but she didn't want them. SpongeBob loves them, but the squeaking drives Mr. Krabs crazy.

videos.title: Nature Pants
videos.overview: SpongeBob wants to give up his current life to live with the jellyfish against the wishes of all his friends. But, SpongeBob learns that a jellyfish life is not an easy one.

videos.title: Opposite Day
videos.overview: Squidward gets so mad at SpongeBob and Patrick, he decides to sell his house. Squidward needs to get rid of his annoying neighbors so he can sell his house. He tells SpongeBob and Patrick that it is "Opposite Day." Squid hopes that they will act the opposite of what they usually are, annoying. Of course, it doesn't work out as planned.

videos.title: Culture Shock
videos.overview: A talent show is taking place at the Krusty Krab to get more customers and more money, and Squidward is in charge. He will do anything to prevent SpongeBob from doing participating in it.

videos.title: F.U.N.
videos.overview: SpongeBob thinks that Plankton is evil only because he is lonely and has no friends. SpongeBob becomes Plankton's friend and plays with him. But, Mr. Krabs is convinced that Plankton is evil and that SpongeBob should not be hanging around with him.

videos.title: MuscleBob BuffPants
videos.overview: SpongeBob thinks he can get more attention if he becomes physically fit. But he soon finds that exercise is hard work, and orders "anchor arms," which he inflates with air, and looks buff. Everyone finds out how fake he is when Sandy signs him up for the annual anchor toss competition at Muscle Beach.

videos.title: Squidward the Unfriendly Ghost
videos.overview: SpongeBob thinks he accidentally killed Squidward, so Squidward decides to use it for his advantage. Threatening to haunt them for the rest of their lives, Squidward makes SpongeBob and Patrick his servants.

videos.title: The Chaperone
videos.overview: SpongeBob takes Pearl to the prom because her previous prom date dumped her, and she is very emotional about it. SpongeBob and Pearl cause all kinds of mischief, and they eventually get thrown out of the prom.

videos.title: Employee of the Month
videos.overview: SpongeBob must try to uphold his position as "Employee of the Month," which he has won for 27 months in a row. But, when Squidward tells him the award is a scam, SpongeBob starts to tease Squidward by saying he could never be "Employee of the Month." videos.title: I Was a Teenage Gary

videos.title: SB-129
videos.overview: Squidward becomes frozen while hiding from SpongeBob and Patrick. He stays frozen for so long, he wakes up in the future. Once he's in the future, he thinks he will be able to get away from SpongeBob and Patrick, but it seems where ever he goes, they are always there somehow.

videos.title: Karate Choppers
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Sandy just can't stop practicing karate, even after Mr. Krabs warns SpongeBob that he will be fired. Soon Mr. Krabs finds them in the park using karate to make sandwiches, so he hires them both to make Krabby Patties at a super fast rate using Karate.

videos.title: Sleepy Time
videos.overview: SpongeBob leaves his dream in order to see what everyone else is dreaming about. But the other citizens of Bikini Bottom don't appreciate this because in the process of his "Dream Exploring" he wakes everyone up and disturbs their sleep.

videos.title: Suds
videos.overview: SpongeBob becomes sick after he leaves the door to the fridge open, and his house becomes icy. But when he gets ready to go to the doctor, Patrick scares him, and tries to cure SpongeBob himself.

videos.title: Valentine's Day
videos.overview: SpongeBob wants to give Patrick the best Valentine's Day gift ever, a chocolate heart shaped hot air balloon. Sandy starts to drive it over to SpongeBob and Patrick at the Valentine Day fair but, scallops attack the balloon, and SpongeBob must stall for time. Patrick goes crazy waiting for his gift, and starts to attack people at the fair.

videos.title: The Paper
videos.overview: SpongeBob gets a small piece of paper from Squidward to play with. Squidward thinks that the paper is useless and just gives it away. SpongeBob soon does many fun things with it, and makes Squidward very jealous.

videos.title: Arrgh!
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick play a pirate board game based on a real treasure map. Mr. Krabs joins in and wins a bunch of times in a row. The next day, Mr. Krabs takes the two boys on a treasure hunt, but they find out later that Mr. Krabs is using the game as a map, and is going crazy trying to find the Flying Dutchman's treasure.

videos.title: Rock Bottom
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally get on the wrong bus coming out of an amusement park called Glove World, and head for a city named Rock Bottom. When they get there, Patrick gets on a bus back to Bikini Bottom, and leaves SpongeBob by mistake. How will SpongeBob ever get home?

videos.title: Texas
videos.overview: Sandy gets homesick, so SpongeBob and Patrick do as much as they can to cheer her up. When they want to throw her a surprise party and she won't come, SpongeBob and Patrick make Sandy chase them to the Krusty Krab, where the party is being held.

videos.title: Walking Small
videos.overview: Plankton's newest scheme involves getting someone to scare everyone away from "Goo Lagoon" so he can create his new restaurant, "The Mega Bucket." He tricks SpongeBob into scaring everyone away from the beach, until SpongeBob realizes what he is doing is wrong.

videos.title: Fools in April
videos.overview: Squidward wakes up and finds out it is April Fools Day. April Fools Day is SpongeBob's favorite holiday so Squidward becomes paranoid, thinking SpongeBob will play a joke on him. Squidward plays a mean trick on SpongeBob, but after SpongeBob runs home crying, Squidward must apologize.

videos.title: Neptune's Spatula
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick go to the Fry Cook Museum and are looking at the exhibits, when they come across the a spatula stuck in hardened grease. This spatula could only be pulled out by a fry cook worthy enough to cook for Neptune himself. SpongeBob pulls the spatula out with ease, and is excepted to move to Atlantis as Neptune's fry cook! But, when Neptune tells SpongeBob he cannot bring his friends, SpongeBob starts to reconsider. Will SpongeBob leave his friends behind?

videos.title: Hooky
videos.overview: Patrick introduces SpongeBob to a carnival but this "carnival" is really colored fishing hooks dropped by fishermen on land. Mr. Krabs warns SpongeBob to stay away and how dangerous they are, but Patrick keeps on talking about how fun they are. Who will SpongeBob listen to, Patrick or Mr. Krabs?

videos.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy II
videos.overview: SpongeBob is awarded a prize for his life size Krabby Patty sculptures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy. The prize is the "Magic Conch" as seen in many episodes of the television show "The Adventures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy." The conch shell, when blown, will make a noise and Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy will come running! It is meant only for danger. SpongeBob blows the conch for simple chores. Will the heroes be so annoyed they must take back the conch?

videos.title: Something Smells
videos.overview: SpongeBob eats a peanut onion sundae and acquires a hideous case of bad breath. And he can't quite understand why everyone runs away from him whenever he talks to them.

videos.title: Bossy Boots
videos.overview: When Pearl remodels the Krusty Krab into a hip local hangout, SpongeBob worries about the fate of the original restaurant (not to mention, his position as Fry Cook!).

videos.title: Your Shoe's Untied
videos.overview: SpongeBob forgets how to tie his shoes, so he must re-learn how. But no one else knows how, either.

videos.title: Squid's Day Off
videos.overview: Squidward is put in charge of the Krusty Krab when Mr. Krabs goes to the hospital and decides to take the day off, but can't help thinking SpongeBob will do something wrong.

videos.title: Big Pink Loser
videos.overview: Patrick realizes that he has never won any awards in his life, so he decides to copy everything that SpongeBob does. SpongeBob has won countless awards, so Patrick is sure that he will win one.

videos.title: Bubble Buddy
videos.overview: When no one will play with SpongeBob, he creates his own bubble buddy, but it causes many problems around town.

videos.title: Mermaid Man & Barnacle Boy III
videos.overview: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy decide to go on vacation, but unfortunately they don't have anyone to look after the Merma-lair, so they ask SpongeBob and Patrick to look after it. However, they accidentally release Man Ray from a prison made of frozen tartar sauce.

videos.title: Squirrel Jokes
videos.overview: SpongeBob tells jokes in a talent show at the Krusty Krab, but ends up saying jokes about squirrels, which makes Sandy mad.

videos.title: Christmas Who?
videos.overview: SpongeBob brings Christmas to Bikini Bottom.

videos.title: Dying for Pie
videos.overview: It's employee brotherhood day and Squidward has nothing to give to SpongeBob, so he accidentally gives SpongeBob a pie bomb. Squidward spends the whole day with SpongeBob because SpongeBob only has one day to live.

videos.title: Imitation Krabs
videos.overview: In another attempt to steal the Krabby Patty formula, Plankton makes a robot that looks just like Mr. Krabs. But in order to get the formula, he will have to do some odd things as part of the "secret handshake."

videos.title: Wormy
videos.overview: Sandy is going away and calls SpongeBob and Patrick to take care of her pets. One of them is a worm, and SpongeBob and Patrick have fun with it all day long, until the next day when it transforms into a butterfly and everybody in town gets scared of it.

videos.title: Patty Hype
videos.overview: The Krusty Krab hasn't had costumers in weeks, so SpongeBob comes up with an idea, but Mr. Krabs and Squidward laugh at the idea. So SpongeBob opens his own restaurant and becomes a huge success in Bikini Bottom.

videos.title: Survival of the Idiots
videos.overview: Despite Sandy's warning, SpongeBob and Patrick sneak into her treedome, during a terrible snowstorm and since the doorknob is frozen, SpongeBob and Patrick realize they have to wait until spring. Will SpongeBob and Patrick be able to survive the entire winter? Or will Sandy, and the cold weather, stop them first?

videos.title: Dumped
videos.overview: Suddenly, Gary seems to be hanging out with Patrick more than SpongeBob. SpongeBob thinks it's because he loves Patrick more. But, what's the real reason that Gary is attached to Patrick all of a sudden?

videos.title: Grandma's Kisses
videos.overview: SpongeBob asks his grandma not to kiss him because her public displays of affection are embarrassing.

videos.title: Squidville
videos.overview: Squidward is fed up with living next to Spongebob and Patrick, so he finds new neighbors who are more like himself.

videos.title: No Free Rides
videos.overview: To avoid another year with SpongeBob in her class, Mrs. Puff passes him with bogus extra credit and lets him have his license, but soon realizes that the consequences are beyond bad. When SpongeBob receives a new boat-mobile from his parents, Mrs. Puff attempts to steal it, and SpongeBob will stop at nothing to stop her.

videos.title: I'm Your Biggest Fanatic
videos.overview: While at a jellyfishing fan convention, SpongeBob meets Kevin C. Cucumber, who gives him a chance to see if he can join his club, The Jellyspotters. However, SpongeBob is unaware that Kevin is only trying to make a fool out of him, but soon discovers the truth after the club attacks him with a robotic queen jellyfish.

videos.title: Pressure
videos.overview: Sandy and SpongeBob get into a fierce competition doing extreme underwater sports.

videos.title: The Smoking Peanut
videos.overview: SpongeBob accidentally throws a peanut at Clamu the Oyster and then the police think that the one who threw the peanut was Patrick.

videos.title: Shanghaied
videos.overview: When a giant anchor falls onto SpongeBob's house, Squidward, SpongeBob and Patrick decide to climb the anchor, and they find the boat of the Flying Dutchman, who imprisons them.

videos.title: Prehibernation Week
videos.overview: Sandy is going wild over the fact that she will have to hibernate in a week.

videos.title: Life of Crime
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick find out that you can borrow anything without permission as long as you return it, or that's what wise Mr. Krabs says. SpongeBob and Patrick want a balloon, but neither one has any money, so they "borrow" it and it pops. They decide to run away and live like criminals, because they think they're now "thieves."

videos.title: The Secret Box
videos.overview: Patrick keeps a small box everywhere he goes and refuses to tell SpongeBob what's in it. Curiosity eventually gets the better of our spongy hero, as he decides to try and sneak a peek while Patrick is sleeping.

videos.title: Band Geeks
videos.overview: Squidward enlists the aid of SpongeBob and the rest of Bikini Bottom to form a marching band to impress Squidward's old high school rival, Squilliam Fancyson.

videos.title: Sailor Mouth
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick pick up a "bad word," and start repeating it to the shocked patrons of the Krusty Krab, but Mr. Krabs doesn't like this!

videos.title: Artist Unknown
videos.overview: Squidward starts to teach an art class at the Recreation Center, but SpongeBob is the only person who shows up.

videos.title: Jellyfish Hunter
videos.overview: Mr. Krab's turns SpongeBob's idea for 'Jelly Krabby Patties' into a colossal customer favorite, and it leads to trouble when the local population of jellyfish become hunted to near-extinction.

videos.title: The Fry Cook Games
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick compete in the Fry Cook Games after they get in a fight. Who will come out victorious?

videos.title: Just One Bite
videos.overview: When SpongeBob learns that Squidward has never actually tried a Krabby Patty, he becomes obsessed with the idea that Squidward must try it.

videos.title: The Bully
videos.overview: At boating school, a new student shows up, but he says he's gonna kick SpongeBob's butt!

videos.title: Squid on Strike
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Squidward go on strike after they don't get their paycheck from Mr. Krabs. How long will the strike last?

videos.title: Sandy, SpongeBob, and the Worm
videos.overview: An Alaskan Bull Worm is on the loose in Bikini Bottom, and Sandy must stop it from destroying the town.

videos.title: Procrastination
videos.overview: SpongeBob must write an 800-word essay for boating school but gets distracted easily.

videos.title: I'm with Stupid
videos.overview: Patrick's parents are coming over and Patrick doesn't want to look stupid, so he tells SpongeBob to be stupider than him.

videos.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy IV
videos.overview: After Mermaid Man accidentally drops his utility belt, SpongeBob finds it and can't resist trying it on.

videos.title: Doing Time
videos.overview: After SpongeBob accidentally drives into a shipment of juice to the senior home, Mrs. Puff is mistakenly arrested.

videos.title: Welcome to the Chum Bucket
videos.overview: SpongeBob is forced to work at the Chum Bucket.

videos.title: Frankendoodle
videos.overview: SpongeBob creates DoodleBob.

videos.title: Snowball Effect
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick try to show Squidward how much fun it can be to play in the snow.

videos.title: One Krab's Trash
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs has a garage sale and sells SpongeBob the most valuable of items.

videos.title: Nasty Patty
videos.overview: A health inspector shows up at the Krusty Krab, and while he is there, SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs see the news about a guy passing himself off as a health inspector to get free food.  Mr. Krabs is so mad he and SpongeBob make a Krabby Patty made with a bunch of nasty things. After it is served to the inspector he chokes on a fly and the two think he died from the patty. They later find out that he was a real health inspector, and that the other one was caught. Now, what will SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs do with the dead health inspector?

videos.title: Idiot Box
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick buy a big screen TV, just so they can use the box using imagination, while Squidward refuses to believe that they are using their imagination inside the box on account of all the noise they are making.

videos.title: As Seen on TV
videos.overview: After SpongeBob has a small role in a commercial for the Krusty Krab, he thinks he is now famous.

videos.title: Can You Spare a Dime?
videos.overview: Squidward quits his job after Mr. Krabs accuses him of stealing the first dime he ever made, but Squidward has a hard time finding a new job.

videos.title: No Weenies Allowed
videos.overview: Spongebob must find a way to prove that he's tough so he can get into the Salty Spitoon.

videos.title: Squilliam Returns
videos.overview: When Squidward's old school rival, Squilliam, returns to Bikini Bottom to brag to Squidward, Squidward tells him that he owns a five star restaurant to get him to stop. Squidward must get Spongebob to turn the Krusty Krab into a fancy restaurant before Squilliam arrives.

videos.title: The Algae's Always Greener
videos.overview: Plankton invents a machine enabling him to switch lives with Mr. Krabs, but he finds out that Mr. Krab's life isn't as good as it seems.

videos.title: SpongeGuard on Duty
videos.overview: SpongeBob volunteers for a lifeguard job, despite the fact that he can't swim.

videos.title: Krab Borg
videos.overview: After watching a horror movie, SpongeBob thinks that Mr. Krabs is a robot.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Bivalve
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick find an abandoned clam and decide to take care of it.

videos.title: Wet Painters
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs has SpongeBob and Patrick paint the inside of his house, with a strict rule to not get paint on anything besides the walls.

videos.title: Krusty Krab Training Video
videos.overview: A training video for new employees of the Krusty Krab, which goes over the basics of being a good employee.

videos.title: Party Pooper Pants
videos.overview: SpongeBob buys a "Throw The Best Party Ever" kit and invites all 177 of his closest friends to a house party. But when he accidentally locks himself out of his house during the party, he must try to get back in.

videos.title: Chocolate with Nuts
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick decide to become rich entrepreneurs by selling chocolate bars door to door.

videos.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy V
videos.overview: After being treated too much like a child by everyone, Barnacle Boy quits being a superhero and decides to be a supervillain.

videos.title: Club SpongeBob
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick's club is too small for Squidward... literally. But Squidward forces his way in, "propelling" the clubhouse into the middle of nowhere.

videos.title: My Pretty Seahorse
videos.overview: It's spring in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob finds a wild seahorse and decides to keep her.

videos.title: Graveyard Shift
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Squidward work the night shift.

videos.title: Krusty Love
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs falls in love with Mrs. Puff.

videos.title: New Student Starfish
videos.overview: Patrick gets bored everyday when SpongeBob goes to boating school, so SpongeBob insists that Patrick could join him. But what happens when Patrick makes SpongeBob lose a Noodle Student Star?

videos.title: Clams
videos.overview: In celebration of Mr. Krabs' one millionth dollar, he takes Squidward and SpongeBob on a fishing trip. After a giant clam snatches his precious dollar, Mr. Krabs tries to get it back.

videos.title: The Great Snail Race
videos.overview: When Squidward gets a purebred snail named Snelle, SpongeBob challenges him in the great snail race.

videos.title: Mid-Life Crustacean
videos.overview: When Mr. Krabs feels like an aging old man, he tries to feel young again, so he goes out with SpongeBob and Patrick for a night on the town.

videos.title: The Sponge Who Could Fly
videos.overview: SpongeBob tries his best to make an invention that allows him to fly. When all of them fail, people start to think that SpongeBob is crazy until he puts a hair dryer his pants. The hot air in his pants allows him to fly! But then, people start asking SpongeBob to do things for them, stopping him from flying with the jellyfish.

videos.title: Gary Takes a Bath
videos.overview: The day that Gary has to take a bath arrives, but he doesn't want to take one.

videos.title: Born Again Krabs
videos.overview: After Mr. Krabs eats a rotten Krabby Patty to save money, he ends up hospitalized for food poisoning and bargains with the Flying Dutchman for his soul, leading him to second-guess his cheap and miserly ways.

videos.title: I Had an Accident
videos.overview: After SpongeBob shatters his buttocks in a sandboarding injury, he becomes paranoid of everything and confines himself to his own home with inanimate objects for friends.

videos.title: Missing Identity
videos.overview: While at a diner, SpongeBob tells the story of when he lost his name tag.

videos.title: Plankton's Army
videos.overview: It's the 25th anniversary of Plankton's first attempt to steal the Krabby Patty Secret Formula, and Plankton enlists his relatives to help him try again.

videos.title: Ugh
videos.overview: SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward's long ago ancestors, SpongeGar, Pattar, and Squagg, discover fire.

videos.title: Krabby Land
videos.overview: The first day of summer lures Mr. Krabs into making a children's theme park, which doesn't turn out the way he thinks it should.

videos.title: The Camping Episode
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick decide to go camping for the weekend, they camp out in the backyard. Squidward lures a sea bear to the campsite by doing stuff that would allure a sea bear.

videos.title: SpongeBob Meets the Strangler
videos.overview: SpongeBob goes on his early litter patrol when he catches The Strangler. After he calls the police, The Strangler (disguised with a fake mustache) decides to be SpongeBob's bodyguard. After three parties at SpongeBob's house, The Strangler tries to strangle SpongeBob, but never gets the chance to be alone.

videos.title: Pranks a Lot
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick buy a prank called Invisible Spray. After taunting each other with the spray, they run out and decide to haunt Bikini Bottom while being invisible, preferably being ghosts. But with their last victim Mr. Krab, he washes them out with water and exposes them nude (they took their clothes off because the spray stains clothes) to the whole Krusty Krab, embarrassing them.

videos.title: Fear of a Krabby Patty
videos.overview: Plankton unleashes a new plan; to get the Krusty Krab to work 24 hours. SpongeBob thinks this is a dream, until he thinks he is being chased by killer Krabby Patties.

videos.title: Shell of a Man
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs is going to a naval reunion, but molts (leaves his shell) before he goes. He asks SpongeBob to go in his shell and imitate him for the reunion.

videos.title: The Lost Mattress
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs complains that his back hurts, so SpongeBob and Patrick buy a new mattress and Squidward tries to take credit for it. They give the new mattress to Mr. Krabs, but Mr. Krabs put his money in his old mattress, which SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward must find while Mr. Krabs is at the hospital.

videos.title: Krabs vs. Plankton
videos.overview: Plankton tries to steal the formula, but slips and sues Mr. Krabs. Mr. Krabs hires a lawyer, but his lawyer slips and is hurt, so SpongeBob must try to help Mr. Krabs win the case by trying to open a briefcase that has something very important in it.

videos.title: Skill Crane
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs gets a new toy vender by the name of "Skill Crane." At first, Squidward doesn't like it, but when Mr. Krabs lets him and SpongeBob give it a try, Squidward becomes obsessed with it. Can he win anything from the Skill Crane before it ruins his life?

videos.title: Good Neighbors
videos.overview: It's Sunday and Squidward just wants to relax. But when SpongeBob and Patrick elect him as Good Neighbor President, they won't leave him alone.

videos.title: Selling Out
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs sells the Krusty Krab to a conglomerate that plans to turn it into a big corporate chain.

videos.title: Funny Pants
videos.overview: Squidward fools SpongeBob into thinking that he has a laughter-related illness and convinces SpongeBob that if he laughs one more time in the next 24 hours, his laugh box could explode.

videos.title: Mermaid Man & Barnacle Boy VI - The Motion Picture
videos.overview: The adventures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy are being told in a thrilling new motion picture. But after SpongeBob learns the heroes will be played by young actors, he sets out to make his own version of the movie using the real guys, fresh from their retirement home.

videos.title: Enemy In-Law
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs' mom is dating again, and it seems like things could be serious. Krabs tries to be happy for his mother, but he is absolutely horrified when he learns that the secret paramour is his arch-rival Plankton! Convinced that this just another trick aimed at getting the family formula for Krabby Patties, Krabs tries to reveal Plankton's schemes and break up the ill-favored fling.

videos.title: Patrick SmartPants
videos.overview: After Patrick accidentally falls off a cliff while jellyfishing, he wakes up with superior intellect.

videos.title: SquidBob TentaclePants
videos.overview: Sandy's experimental teleportation device malfunctions, melding SpongeBob and Squidward into one body.

videos.title: Have You Seen This Snail?
videos.overview: While trying to beat a paddle-ball world record, SpongeBob forgets to feed Gary -- for 10 days. Gary runs away to downtown Bikini Bottom where he is taken in by a kindly old woman who confuses him with one of her many deceased pets. Once SpongeBob realizes that he has neglected Gary, he sets out in a town-wide search for him. Meanwhile, as Gary is wrapped in comfy blankets and indulged in an endless assortment of snacks, he discovers a very dark secret about this sweet old woman...

videos.title: Dunces and Dragons
videos.overview: After a freak jousting accident at a Medieval Times-style restaurant, SpongeBob and Patrick are transported to a medieval version of Bikini Bottom. There they are mistaken for great knights and sent on a quest by King Krabs to rescue his daughter, the Princess Pearl, from the clutches of the evil wizard Planktonamor.

videos.title: Krusty Towers
videos.overview: After Mr. Krab's gets a huge hotel bill he decides that he can make a profit from opening his own. When Patrick decides to visit the hotel Mr. Krabs demands Squidward to never deny a guest even the most ridiculous request, but after Patrick frustrates Squidward so badly he quits his job. Then he decides to check into the Krusty Towers.

videos.title: Mrs. Puff, You're Fired
videos.overview: Mrs. Puff gets fired from her boating school job due to her lack of passing Spongebob. Instead, a more-intense new instructor takes her place.

videos.title: Chimps Ahoy
videos.overview: The Chimpanzee beneficiaries of Sandy's undersea treedome are paying a visit to see what progress she has made with her inventions. But Sandy doesn't think any of her work will satisfy the chimps, and if they don't like what she's invented Sandy could lose her funding forcing her to leave Bikini Bottom. SpongeBob and Patrick decide to help their distraught friend by taking over her work and finishing her inventions.

videos.title: Ghost Host
videos.overview: The Flying Dutchman takes up residence at SpongeBob's house where he proceeds to scare, startle and surprise SpongeBob around the clock. Eventually all the spooky shenanigans grow old, and SpongeBob is no longer afraid of the Dutchman. This creates a panic for the old ghost who now fears that he has lost his scary touch. So SpongeBob decides to lend a hand and help the Flying Dutchman learn to scare people again.

videos.title: Whale of a Birthday
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs wants to give his daughter Pearl the best birthday ever. While he works on the party, SpongeBob is assigned the task of figuring out what Pearl would like for a present. So he trails her through the Bikini Bottom mall and takes note of everything she thinks is "Coral." Once Pearl arrives at her party she is horrified to find that her dad's miserly ways have won out again. What was supposed to be the most fun and fabulous event ended up cheap and lame. It looks like Pearl's birthday will go down in history as the worst one ever - until SpongeBob shows up with a truck-load of presents. Everything Pearl looked at in the mall was so Coral that SpongeBob bought it all - maxing out Mr. Krab's credit card in the process.

videos.title: Karate Island
videos.overview: SpongeBob receives an invitation to take part in a competition on mysterious Karate Island for the chance to be crowned "King of Karate." SpongeBob and Sandy arrive at Karate Island and it turns out that it was just all a set-up to make SpongeBob buy real estate.

videos.title: All That Glitters
videos.overview: When a customer orders the one thing that no one has ordered for years, the monster krabby patty, SpongeBob tries to lift it, but old Spat cracks in two. So he sells every single thing he owns (plus his clothes) for a new spatula, but the spatula refuses to flip a single patty, so SpongeBob tries to get his old spatula back. Will Spat forgive him? Will SpongeBob ever be dressed again?

videos.title: Wishing You Well
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs makes SpongeBob go down the new wishing well after experiencing one for himself, and Patrick and Squidward accidentally join in. So, will they be able to get out and watch everybody's wishes come true? Or will Mr. Krabs just make them stay down there when he enjoys the money?

videos.title: New Leaf
videos.overview: In the battle for fast food supremacy, Plankton has decided to throw in the towel and start a new business selling trinkets and souvenir gifts. He even renames his store from The Chum Bucket to The Chumporium. But Mr. Krabs doesn't buy the change for a second. He's determined to prove that this is nothing more than one of Plankton's elaborate schemes aimed at stealing the Krabby Patty formula.

videos.title: Once Bitten
videos.overview: Gary starts biting everyone in town, starting with Squidward. When Squid asks if Gary has been up-to-date on all of his snail shots, SpongeBob reveals that he's never done any of that before. This only sends Squidward into a panic. Does he now have some rare snail-related disease? Is this the end for Squidward?

videos.title: Squidtastic Voyage
videos.overview: While Squidward is playing the clarinet, he accidentally swallows the reed. SpongeBob and Patrick take a microscopic submarine to try to retrieve it from inside Squidward.

videos.title: Bummer Vacation
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs forces SpongeBob to take a vacation, but he doesn't know how. Meanwhile, Patrick takes SpongeBob's place as fry cook.

videos.title: Best Day Ever
videos.overview: SpongeBob is going to have the best day ever. But when work, karate, jellyfishing and Squidward's clarinet recital don't go as planned will his day be ruined?

videos.title: Wigstruck
videos.overview: SpongeBob finds an old-time wig and starts wearing it everywhere he goes.

videos.title: That's No Lady
videos.overview: A misunderstanding over a vacation getaway advertisement causes Patrick to think he must "get out of town" or face dire consequences. SpongeBob can't bear the thought of his best buddy moving away, so he decides to do what he can to hide Patrick's identity from his "pursuers." After many failed attempts at disguises, they finally settle on the perfect one: Patrick is transformed into a girl, Patricia, to be exact. Patricia catches the eye of Mr. Krabs and soon she becomes the most charming waitress/waiter at the Krusty Krab.

videos.title: The Thing
videos.overview: After being covered in cement, the Bikini Bottomites are convinced that Squidward is an unknown species and SpongeBob tries to keep him as a pet.

videos.title: Hocus Pocus
videos.overview: SpongeBob tries out his new magic kit on Squidward and is convinced he's turned his neighbor into an ice cream cone!

videos.title: Driven to Tears

videos.overview: Take a look inside Patrick Star's rock, where we see that his morning routine is anything but ordinary.

But now that customers already have their smoothie, they don't need to buy a beverage with their Krusty Krab order. This could hurt Mr. Krabs' profits.

videos.title: Boat Smarts

videos.title: The Krusty Sponge

videos.title: Squid Wood
videos.overview: Rejected yet again by Squidward, SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

videos.title: New Digs

videos.overview: SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward enter a dance contest, but when Squidward fails to proceed to the finals, he decides to coach SpongeBob to win the trophy.

videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick organize a party in the Treedome to welcome Sandy, who is returning from Texas. However, unknown to her, Sandy has carried back fleas.

videos.title: The Donut of Shame

videos.title: Mermaid Man vs SpongeBob
videos.overview: After Plankton turns Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy into his minions with his mind controlling device, he controls the heroes and orders them to encourage the customers of the Krusty Krab to eat at the Chum Bucket.

videos.title: Atlantis SquarePantis
videos.overview: SpongeBob and his friends journey to Atlantis, where each member of the group is charmed by an attraction.

videos.title: The Inmates of Summer

videos.overview: Plankton creates a band to steal the Krabby Patty secret recipe.

videos.overview: Squidward writes a symphony.

videos.title: Spongicus

videos.overview: While researching his family tree, SpongeBob finds that he is a distant relative of SpongeBuck, a sheriff from Bikini Bottom's past who helped save the citizens from the quickest whip draw in town, the evil Dead Eye Plankton.

videos.title: The Splinter

videos.overview: When SpongeBob tries to spend quality time with his friends, he just ends up being a nuisance to them instead. He has no other choice but to pack and move to another city. In the process, he hits his head, loses all of his memory and wanders away into a new town.

videos.title: Grooming Gary

videos.overview: Mr. Krabs wants to manage SpongeBob and Patrick as a tag-team wrestling duo to win $1,000,000.

videos.overview: SpongeBob ditches boating school, then gets distracted on his way back.

videos.title: Slide Whistle Stooges

videos.overview: SpongeBob, Patrick, Squidward, Sandy, and Mr. Krabs must ride a big wave to get back home.

videos.overview: Plankton explores SpongeBob's brain, in an attempt to steal the formula.

Plankton then gets the secret formula, but SpongeBob accidentally overpowers the gas canister by bashing it, causing it to explode. The gas turns Plankton into a microscopic baby.

videos.overview: The Flying Dutchman turns SpongeBob and Patrick into ghosts.

videos.overview: Squidward gets caught littering and is sentenced to community service.

videos.overview: SpongeBob and the rest of the Bikini Bottomites travel to Texas to try to save Sandy from a rodeo.

videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally change past events with Mermaid Man's time machine.

videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick watch a lost episode of The Adventures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy.

videos.overview: Squidward bets that SpongeBob cannot go 24 hours without crying.

videos.overview: To pay off the damage she causes, Mrs. Puff works with SpongeBob at the Krusty Krab for free.

videos.overview: While sharing a locker with SpongeBob, Squidward finds a sacred world for clarinets only.

videos.overview: Mr. Krabs discovers that Plankton is afraid of whales, and uses his daughter Pearl to scare him.

videos.title: The Play's the Thing
videos.overview: Squidward executes his play at the Krusty Krab.

videos.title: SpongeBob's Last Stand
videos.overview: Jellyfish Fields is threatened by the construction of a highway built by Plankton.

videos.overview: Squidward gets to live in the world of his dreams, thanks to SpongeBob and Patrick.

videos.overview: To avoid irritating Squidward, SpongeBob and Patrick dig a tunnel under their houses, much to Squidward's annoyance.

videos.overview: SpongeBob teaches Patrick karate, causing mayhem in Bikini Bottom.

videos.overview: Mr. Krabs is nominated for being the cheapest crab alive.

videos.overview: SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward get locked inside a time capsule.

videos.overview: Squidward erects a statue of Mr. Krabs to try and attract customers.

videos.overview: SpongeBob tries to bring the Krabby Patty back after Mr. Krabs removes them in exchange for hot dogs.

videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick find a lost ship, which Mr. Krabs uses for financial gain.

videos.overview: When cooking up a new batch of Krabby Patties, Mr. Krabs accidentally sends the formula away to the other side of the ocean, and sends SpongeBob and Patrick to fetch it.

videos.overview: Gary orders SpongeBob a product that helps him say no to anyone that needs SpongeBob's help.

videos.title: Earworm
videos.overview: SpongeBob becomes addicted to a song and cannot stop singing it.

videos.title: New Fish in Town
videos.overview: Squidward becomes friends with his new neighbor.

videos.title: Big Sister Sam
videos.overview: Patrick's older sister Sam comes to visit him.

videos.title: Sponge-Cano!
videos.overview: A volcanic eruption brings an ancient warrior to Bikini Bottom with dire predictions.

videos.title: The Main Drain
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick seek out a legendary drain that once destroyed Bikini Bottom.

videos.title: The Monster Who Came to Bikini Bottom
videos.overview: Patrick befriends a monster.

videos.title: Welcome to the Bikini Bottom Triangle
videos.overview: SpongeBob and his pals get trapped in the Bikini Bottom Triangle.

videos.title: Trench Billies
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick are held prisoners by a backward gang.

videos.title: Love That Squid
videos.overview: Squidward gets ready to go out on a date and SpongeBob assists him with a "practice date."

videos.title: Tunnel of Glove
videos.overview: Pearl and SpongeBob become stuck inside the Tunnel of Glove.

videos.title: Perfect Chemistry
videos.overview: Sandy makes a teleporter, which Plankton tries to use to steal the formula.

videos.title: A Friendly Game
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick decide to build an indoor miniature golf course in SpongeBob's pineapple house after it has rained outside. Squidward, who was sleeping and annoyed, tells the two to keep the noise down in constructing the course. They must not disturb Squidward, while Patrick distracts SpongeBob to make him lose in the process.

videos.title: Oral Report
videos.overview: While preparing to give an oral report for boating school, SpongeBob comes down with stage fright. SpongeBob asks Sandy for help, and receives a pair of goggles that would enable him to see people in their undergarments, so he will not feel nervous. However, in his oral presentation, his goggles malfunction, which makes SpongeBob to panic and run out with a boatmobile. Beating the red light, it calls the attention of a police, who starts chasing after him.

videos.title: Sentimental Sponge
videos.overview: Squidward becomes concerned when Patrick convinces SpongeBob that he needs to become more sentimental.

videos.title: Squidward's School for Grown Ups
videos.overview: When Patrick suddenly grows a beard, he decides it is time to act like a grown-up. He tags along with Squiward, who offers to teach him everything he knows about how to be mature, much to SpongeBob's dismay.

videos.title: The Curse of the Hex
videos.overview: An evil hagfish curses the Krusty Krab.

videos.title: The Hot Shot
videos.overview: SpongeBob gets driving lessons from the son of a legendary race-car driver, Tony Fast Jr.

videos.title: The Other Patty
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs and Plankton, his business rival and Chum Bucket owner, set out to find clues on why they have no customers. The enemies find a common enemy—a popular new restaurant—in which they must work together to steal the secret formula of its "Flabby Patty" burgers.

videos.title: Frozen Face-Off
videos.overview: SpongeBob and the gang, including Patrick, Mr. Krabs, Squidward, Sandy Cheeks, Plankton and Karen, and Gary, participate in a sled worm race for one million dollars. However, just before the race begins, Plankton sneaks off to the Krusty Krab and uses a robot as his replacement in the race. Plankton goes inside the Krusty Krab to steal the Krabby Patty formula, while the group must keep a yeti, who is attacking them, away.

videos.title: Accidents Will Happen
videos.overview: When Squidward gets hurt on the job, he menaces to take legal action unless his employer, Mr. Krabs, agrees to cater to him to his every need. Mr. Krabs, who eventually gets tired of doing everything for Squidward, hires SpongeBob and Patrick to investigate the scene.

videos.title: Drive Thru
videos.overview: Instead of paying money to repair a hole in the wall of the Krusty Krab, Mr. Krabs decides to use it to gain more income by turning it into a drive-thru window. However, his two employees, SpongeBob and Squidward, have difficulty in keeping up with orders, which results to wreak havoc.

videos.title: Sweet and Sour Squid
videos.overview: Plankton tries to befriend Squidward in order to get the Krabby Patty secret formula. However, Squidward refuses to discourse with him until SpongeBob tells Plankton that he must compliment Squidward's music in order to strike up a friendship. The two become friends and share their music to all of Bikini Bottom.

videos.title: The Googly Artiste
videos.overview: When doing arts and crafts with his best friend SpongeBob, Patrick is coveted by everyone in town after an art critic praises his artwork. He soon becomes a famous artist, which makes Squidward jealous. When he reaches an artist's block, Patrick must find new inspirations for his next masterpiece.

videos.title: Barnacle Face
videos.overview: The night before a school dance, Pearl gets a barnacle on her face. Mr. Krabs asks SpongeBob to help his daughter remove the blemish to save money, instead of taking Pearl to expensive treatment.

videos.title: Pet Sitter Pat
videos.overview: When SpongeBob gets an invitation to his Grandma's birthday party, he asks his best friend Patrick to pet-sit Gary. However, Patrick only causes trouble, which makes SpongeBob angry.

videos.title: Mermaid Man Begins
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick learn the secret origins of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy from the heroes themselves.

videos.title: Plankton's Good Eye
videos.overview: Plankton grows himself another eye because he lacks depth perception. However, it changes his personality and causes him to be nice, because the eye is from SpongeBob's DNA.

videos.title: House Sittin' for Sandy
videos.overview: SpongeBob gladly accepts to house sit Sandy's Treedome, while she is away. Sandy first shows SpongeBob what he should do, and all is quiet until Patrick arrives for a visit. The best friend causes chaos and wreak havoc, which results to the house getting destroyed.

videos.title: Smoothe Jazz at Bikini Bottom
videos.overview: Squidward and SpongeBob win backstage passes and tickets to Kelpy G's live concert. However, Patrick eats their passes shortly after the concert begins. Losing their passes, SpongeBob and Squidward try to sneak backstage to meet Kelpy G.

videos.title: Ghoul Fools
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick find a houseboat haunted by a crew of ghost pirates headed by Lord Poltergeist. The two get caught in a feud between them and the Flying Dutchman.

videos.title: Walking the Plankton
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob win free tickets to a cruise, thanks to Plankton, but they do not know that it is a secret plan to steal the Krabby Patty formula. At the same time, Plankton tricks his computer wife Karen for a vacation, and she is initially excited until when she realizes that this is part of his plan to steal the formula. He lies to her and the both hop on the same cruise as Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob.

videos.title: Patrick's Staycation
videos.overview: When feeling that he is doing the same activities every day, Patrick moans that he needs a break. SpongeBob suggests a vacation out of town, which cheers him. When at a travel agency, Patrick is given options, but they are thrown out when it is revealed that he cannot afford a trip. SpongeBob comes up with a solution—a "staycation", a vacation at home—which delights Patrick.

videos.title: Mr. Krabs Takes a Vacation
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs takes a vacation with SpongeBob and Pearl to the Bikini Bottom Mint. However, his daughter does not want to tag along, so she stays at a museum. SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs proceed inside the mint, but the tour guide is instantly annoyed by their antics. When two bank robbers seize the mint, SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs stop them and they are rewarded with a special edition one-dollar bill with their faces on it, but Pearl confiscates the dollars and spends them on a new pair of shoes, causing Mr. Krabs to blast endless tear beams in the mint.

videos.title: Mooncation
videos.overview: SpongeBob meets Sandy, who is preparing her rocket to go to the Moon for a vacation. However, SpongeBob accidentally stows away, and when on the Moon, the two set out camp. SpongeBob and Sandy play sports including sandboarding on its craters. After accidentally crashing the sandboard into the fuel tank, they immediately start the rocket because they need to return home before the fuel runs out.

videos.title: A SquarePants Family Vacation
videos.overview: SpongeBob invites Mr. Krabs, Pearl, Sandy, Mrs. Puff, Larry, Squidward, and Plankton to watch a slideshow of his family vacation to the Great Barrier Reef. In the slideshow, SpongeBob and his parents are on a family road trip with Patrick, but the two best friends get lost and end up in a forest for adventure.

videos.title: The Krabby Patty That Ate Bikini Bottom
videos.overview: While looking for spare change, Mr. Krabs notices an over-sized soybean at Sandy's Treedome. Mr. Krabs is interested in what could have enlarged the plant, and Sandy revealed an experimental growth formula, which Mr. Krabs steals out of sight. At the Krusty Krab, he uses the growth formula on a Krabby Patty, but it keeps on growing until chaos erupts.

videos.title: Bubble Buddy Returns
